historical_record.description: The Malloch Building, 1937, by Irvine W. Goldstine: a rare architect-designed Streamline Moderne apartment building on Telegraph Hill.

historic_survey.note: The Malloch Building on Telegraph Hill, designed in 1937 by Irvine Goldstine and a contributor to the Article 10 Telegraph Hill Historic District. The statement names it as one of the very few individual, architect-designed Streamline Moderne residential buildings in San Francisco.
